description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage financial technology team building banking infrastructure for digital assets and AI. As a founding engineer for its US operations, you will own backend systems end-to-end and help shape core banking technology from the ground up.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship production code early while learning the codebase, domain, and product.

 - Drive major engineering projects from conception through production as a hands-on individual contributor.

 - Translate complex financial and banking needs into reliable software that operates at scale.

 - Make decisions about system design, data modeling, and architectural tradeoffs.

 - Work with engineering, product, and clients to guide the evolution of core banking systems.

 - Build simple, automated systems that reduce recurring manual effort.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of hands-on backend software engineering experience and 1 year in an early-stage or small startup.

 - Production experience building backend or systems software, with depth in banking, financial systems, or large-scale infrastructure.

 - Experience owning major projects end-to-end and making technical decisions for production systems.

 - Ability to write clean, reliable code, ship iteratively, and take ownership of quality.

 - Comfort working in new problem areas without an established playbook.

 - Interest in core banking systems and financial infrastructure.

 - Must be based in New York or willing to relocate for on-site work.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual base salary of $200,000 to $400,000, plus equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, relocation support, and professional development support. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York. Relocation support is available.
